nodes.description: UniswapExchange.transfer(address _to, uint _value) public payable; forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value)
UniswapExchange.ensure(address _from, address _to, uint _value) internal view; whitelist gate that also calls condition and pairFor
UniswapExchange.transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint _value) public payable; mutates balanceOf/allowance/_onSaleNum with unchecked subtraction
UniswapExchange.approve(address _spender, uint _value) public payable; writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender]
UniswapExchange.condition(address _from, uint _value) internal view; enforces _saleNum/_minSale/_maxSale/_onSaleNum sale limits
UniswapExchange.delegate(address a, bytes b) public payable; owner-only arbitrary delegatecall into attacker-supplied target
UniswapExchange.init(uint256 saleNum, uint256 token, uint256 maxToken); owner-only setter of sale parameters
UniswapExchange.batchSend(address[] _tos, uint _value) public payable; owner-only loop with unchecked multiplication and unchecked balance additions
UniswapExchange.setTradeAddress(address addr); owner-only whitelist setter for tradeAddress
UniswapExchange.pairFor(address factory, address tokenA, address tokenB) internal pure; computes CREATE2 pair address via keccak256
UniswapExchange constructor(string _name, string _symbol, uint256 _supply) payable; mints supply to deployer and sets owner
address private owner; privileged account used for all access-control checks
address tradeAddress; whitelisted address accepted inside ensure()
mapping(address=>uint256) private _onSaleNum; per-account sale counter
mapping(address=>bool) private canSale; whitelisted accounts bypassing condition()
uint256 private _minSale; minimum transfer amount enforced by condition()
uint256 private _maxSale; maximum transfer amount enforced by condition()
uint256 private _saleNum; per-address sale cap enforced by condition()
mapping(address=>uint) public balanceOf; token balances mutated in transferFrom and batchSend
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) public allowance; spend approvals
uint public totalSupply; minted once in the constructor
uint constant public decimals = 18; used as exponent in init and constructor scaling
msg.sender; untrusted caller used as _from in transfer/transferFrom and as the owner gate
a.delegatecall(b) in delegate(); arbitrary external code executed in this contract's storage context
balanceOf[_from] -= _value in transferFrom; raw subtraction without SafeMath
uint total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend; raw multiplication that can overflow
_to recipient parameter
_value amount parameter
_from source address parameter
_spender address parameter of approve
a target address parameter of delegate
b calldata bytes parameter of delegate
saleNum parameter of init
token (min sale) parameter of init
maxToken (max sale) parameter of init
_tos recipient address array parameter of batchSend
addr parameter of setTradeAddress
uint total in batchSend; product of _value and _tos.length
uint i loop index in batchSend
_UNI local in ensure(); computed Uniswap pair address used as a whitelist bypass

edges.reason: transfer() forwards execution to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value)
transfer passes msg.sender as the _from argument
_to parameter flows into transferFrom call
_value parameter flows into transferFrom call
transferFrom invokes ensure(_from,_to,_value)
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to]
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender]
transferFrom compares msg.sender with _from and uses it for allowance
_value flows into the unchecked subtraction balanceOf[_from] -= _value
_from parameter controls which balance is debited
_value parameter controls the debited amount
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from]
ensure calls condition(_from,_value) when the sender is not whitelisted
ensure calls pairFor(...) to derive the Uniswap pair address
ensure grants an unconditional bypass when _from or _to equals owner
ensure grants an unconditional bypass when _from equals tradeAddress
ensure grants an unconditional bypass when canSale[_from] is true
_UNI local is computed inside ensure and used in the whitelist comparison
condition reads and enforces _saleNum
condition reads and enforces _minSale
condition reads and enforces _maxSale
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner
_spender parameter is stored as the allowance spender
delegate performs an external delegatecall that can execute arbitrary code in this contract's context
delegate is gated by require(msg.sender == owner)
delegate compares msg.sender against the owner state variable
parameter a is the delegatecall target address
parameter b is the delegatecall payload
init is gated by require(msg.sender == owner)
init compares msg.sender against owner
init writes _minSale from token*(10**decimals)
init writes _maxSale from maxToken*(10**decimals)
init writes _saleNum from the saleNum parameter
init reads decimals to scale the sale bounds
saleNum parameter flows into _saleNum
token parameter flows into _minSale
maxToken parameter flows into _maxSale
batchSend is gated by require(msg.sender == owner)
batchSend compares msg.sender against owner
_value and _tos.length flow into the unchecked product _value * _tos.length
batchSend debits balanceOf[msg.sender] and credits balanceOf[_to] without SafeMath
local total is the overflow-prone product used in the balance check
loop counter i iterates over _tos
_tos array parameter drives the transfer loop
_value parameter is credited to each recipient
setTradeAddress is gated by require(msg.sender == owner)
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress whitelist entry
addr parameter is stored into tradeAddress
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender
constructor sets totalSupply = _supply*(10**decimals)
constructor sets balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply
constructor approves uint(-1) allowance to the UNI router
constructor uses msg.sender as owner and initial holder
pairFor result is consumed by ensure for the Uniswap whitelist bypass

normalization_plan.reason: _to is a value parameter only used by the transfer entry point; merge into transfer
_value is the amount parameter driving balance and allowance mutation in transferFrom
_from is the debited account parameter of transferFrom
_spender is only used to key the allowance mapping in approve
a is the delegatecall target consumed directly by delegate
b is the delegatecall payload consumed directly by delegate
saleNum is only assigned to _saleNum inside init
token is only used to derive _minSale inside init
maxToken is only used to derive _maxSale inside init
_tos is the recipient array iterated by the batchSend loop
addr is written straight into tradeAddress by setTradeAddress
total is the local product of the unsafe multiplication in batchSend
i is the loop counter of the batchSend for-loop
_UNI is computed inside ensure and only used for its whitelist bypass
